resources.string: Open-source utility for locally reading compatible Axioma Qalcosonic W1 water meters over NFC-V / ISO 15693.

Protocol research for the ST25DV mailbox flow, the Qalcosonic M-Bus read sequence and Qalcosonic-specific field mappings was informed by this open-source project. The Android application is a separate Java implementation and does not bundle or link the upstream ESPHome binary/library.
The upstream project and its author are credited so the protocol research lineage remains visible even when this APK is shared separately from its repository.
View GNU LGPL v2.1 license text
Normal NFC readout requires no account, backend or cloud service. The app contains no analytics or automatic telemetry.

Successful live reads and validated meter archive periods are stored locally by meter identity. History can contain the meter number, read and archive times, meter readings, measurements needed for consumption, battery state and alarm/status information.
Not stored in normal persistent history
Normal persistent history does not store the NFC UID, ST25 transport state, mailbox payloads, raw NFC bytes, raw M-Bus frames or diagnostic traces.
Android application backup is disabled for this app. Meter history is therefore not intentionally included in Android system app backup by this application.

CSV exports and .qw1backup files are created only after you explicitly choose a destination. CSV is intended for spreadsheets. The versioned Qalcosonic backup can contain local history, archive integrity metadata, meter-replacement information and portable app settings so they can be restored on another installation.

Data leaves the app only after an explicit user action. Normal data, backup and diagnostic functions stay local until you choose to export or share them. Technical raw diagnostics can contain identifiers or consumption data and should only be shared deliberately.
